study_purpose.text: This study aims to identify genetic factors contributing to prostate cancer.

who_may_join.text: Men with prostate cancer diagnosed at a young age, or those in first-degree related pairs where one is under 65, or three or more relatives with prostate cancer at any age.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will be invited to complete an interview and questionnaires about their preferences and health information. They will also be given an information sheet and consent form.

risks_or_burdens.text: not clearly stated in the retrieved evidence

time_commitment.text: The study involves a single interview and completion of questionnaires.

what_is_unclear: Not clearly stated in the retrieved evidence

patient_facing_summary.text: This study invites men with prostate cancer or their close relatives to participate in interviews and questionnaires. No specific risks or burdens are mentioned.
